senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אצר)store-house, magazine; provision; hoarded up treasure.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 58a">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 67a:8">Git. 67ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00881"><he>בָּלַם</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B00892"><he>בָּלַס</he></cite>.
Ab. Zar. 40ᵇ; v. הֶפְתֵּק; a. fr.—Esp. treasury, the (Roman) government’s treasury department where taxes in kind and money had to be paid.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:8:10">Y. Dem. VI, end, 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ושקול על ידי לא׳</he> and pay for me in the treasury-department.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:4">Tosef. Dem. VI, 4</cite> <he>ושקול תחתיי מן הא׳</he> (read <he>אל הא׳</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>ושוקל לא׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. incorr. <he>ואוצר</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>פוטריני מן הא׳</he> get me a release from the treasury-dep.—Y. Dem. l. c. <he>פרשיני מן הא׳</he> (read <he>פוטריני</he>).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71a:4">Ab. Zar. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>לא׳</he>, <he>מן הא׳</he>, Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="P00325"><he>עוצר</he></cite>); cmp. <cite ref="A02888"><he>אָצַר</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>אוֹצָרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 11a:4">B. Bath. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>גנזו א׳</he> Ms. (ed. <he>א׳</he> omitted); v. <cite ref="C01120"><he>גָּנַז</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Chagigah 12b:10">Ḥag. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹצְרוֹת שלג וכ׳</he> the stores of snow &c. (in the heavens); a. fr. V. <cite ref="A02892"><he>אֹצְרוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02892"><he>א׳ רוח</he></cite>.
